Money Snapshot 1.0.0

Review CSV, OFX, QFX and QBO statements on this device. No bank login, account registration or AI service is connected. Transactions stay in memory until you clear or close the session. Only files you choose to save are exported.

Use fictional data for this preview. Results are educational estimates. Check all categories and statement coverage.
Unsaved analysis and notes will be cleared. Save your report or action plan first if you want to keep them.
This clears the current analysis and unsaved notes. Your original statement files are unchanged.
